_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a Handloom and Handicrafts artisan.
   1. The applicant should be a resident of the U.T. of Dadra and Nagar Haveli &amp; Daman and Diu.
   1. The applicant should be above 18 years of age.
   1. The applicant should belong to the SC/ST/OBC/EWS communities.
   1. The applicant should be engaged in 27 different activities, as mentioned in the [Official Guidelines](https://swp.dddgov.in/assets/pdf/Notification_IPS_2022_DNH_DD.pdf) (Refer page no. 47 &amp; 48 of the document).   1. Applicant’s annual income should be upto ₹2,00,000/- for rural areas and upto ₹2,50,000/- in urban areas.
